# Overview

This document reproduces the co-expression analysis between diatom (host) genes
and bacterial (microbiome) genes:

1. **Choosing k**: elbow method for the number of k-means clusters.
2. **k-means clustering** of z-scored, differentially expressed host and bacterial genes,
   using the published cluster assignments.
3. **Centroid correlation and dendrogram**: host–microbiome cluster associations
   and hierarchical ordering of clusters.
4. **Global host–microbiome network**.
5. **Module expression profiles**: host and bacterial clusters grouped into co-expression modules.
6. **Functional characterisation**: COG composition heatmap and COG enrichment of bacterial clusters.
7. **Taxonomic composition** of bacterial clusters.
8. **PFAM odds ratios** across bacterial clusters.
9. **Export** of gene-level cluster tables for manual exploration.

## Repository layout

```
.
├── host_microbiome_coexpression.Rmd
├── data/      # input files (see list below)
└── output/    # figures and tables written by this document
```

Input files expected in `data/`:

| File | Content | Used in |
|---|---|---|
| `DE_vst_diatom_enrichment.txt` | VST counts, DE diatom genes in COG categories differing between axenic and xenic cultures | 1, 2 |
| `DE_vst_bacteria.txt` | VST counts, DE bacterial genes | 1, 2 |
| `DE_meta_combined.txt` | Sample metadata (columns `Sample`, `Treat`) | 2, 5 |
| `explore_bac_new.xlsx` | Published cluster assignment of bacterial genes (`Gene_ID`, `cid`) | 2 |
| `explore_euk.xlsx` | Published cluster assignment of diatom genes (`Gene_ID`, `cid`) | 2 |
| `global_network_pos.xlsx`, `global_network_neg.xlsx` | Diatom (`H_*`, rows) × bacteria (`M_*`, columns) matrices with the number of positive / negative correlations; only nodes with at least one edge are listed | 4 |
| `Bac_meta_cleaned.xlsx` | eggNOG annotation of bacterial genes (columns `query`, `COG_category`) | 6, 9 |
| `cog_categories.xlsx` | COG letter → process lookup (columns `COG_category`, `process`) | 6 |
| `signif_processes.xlsx` | eggNOG annotation of diatom genes (columns `query`, `COG_category`) | 6, 9 |
| `genes_class.xlsx` | Bacterial genes with cluster ID (`cid.x`), `Class` and `COG_category` | 7 |
| `pfams_odds_upset.csv` | PFAM counts per bacterial cluster with Fisher odds ratios (`;`-separated) | 8 |

# 1. Choosing the number of clusters (elbow method)

k-means is run 100 times for each k = 1–30 on the z-scored diatom genes, and the
total within-cluster sum of squares is plotted per k.

```{r elbow-function}
run_elbow <- function(mat, k_max = 30, n_rep = 100) {
  expand_grid(rep = seq_len(n_rep), k = seq_len(k_max)) %>%
    mutate(error = map_dbl(k, ~ sum(kmeans(mat, centers = .x)$withinss)))
}
```

```{r elbow-diatom, cache=TRUE}
dia_elbow_mat <- read.delim(in_file("DE_vst_diatom_enrichment.txt"), row.names = 1)
dia_elbow_mat <- t(scale(t(dia_elbow_mat)))

elbow_dia <- run_elbow(dia_elbow_mat)

p_elbow_dia <- ggplot(elbow_dia, aes(x = k, y = error, group = k)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(title = "Elbow plot: diatom genes", y = "Total within-cluster SS")
p_elbow_dia

ggsave(out_file("num_clusters.pdf"), p_elbow_dia, width = 7, height = 7)
```

Optimal k for the diatom genes: not more than 11.

The same procedure for the bacterial genes (k = 16 used below) is provided here
but not evaluated by default because it is slow:

```{r elbow-bacteria, eval=FALSE}
bac_elbow_mat <- read.delim(in_file("DE_vst_bacteria.txt"), row.names = 1)
bac_elbow_mat <- t(scale(t(bac_elbow_mat)))

elbow_bac <- run_elbow(bac_elbow_mat)

ggplot(elbow_bac, aes(x = k, y = error, group = k)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(title = "Elbow plot: bacterial genes", y = "Total within-cluster SS")
```

# 2. k-means clustering of host and bacterial genes

## Data import and sample name harmonisation

```{r import}
# DE genes belonging to bacteria
bac_raw <- read.delim(in_file("DE_vst_bacteria.txt"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
# Diatom genes in COG categories that differed between axenic and xenic cultures
euk_raw <- read.delim(in_file("DE_vst_diatom_enrichment.txt"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

meta <- read.delim(in_file("DE_meta_combined.txt"))
sample_order <- meta$Sample

# Replace "-" and "_" by "." and drop everything after the fourth "."
clean_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[-_]", ".", x)
  sub("^(([^.]*[.]){3}[^.]*)[.].*$", "\\1", x)
}
colnames(bac_raw) <- clean_names(colnames(bac_raw))
colnames(euk_raw) <- clean_names(colnames(euk_raw))

# Reorder columns and compute z-scores per gene
bac_z <- t(scale(t(dplyr::select(bac_raw, all_of(sample_order)))))
euk_z <- t(scale(t(dplyr::select(euk_raw, all_of(sample_order)))))
```

## Clustering

```{r kmeans}
k_bac <- 16  # determined with the elbow method
k_dia <- 11

set.seed(124)

# Bacterial genes
kmeans_bac <- kmeans(bac_z, centers = k_bac, iter.max = 50)
bac_genes <- data.frame(bac_z)
bac_genes$cid <- paste("b", kmeans_bac$cluster, sep = "_")
bac_genes$Gene_ID <- rownames(bac_genes)
bac_centroids <- kmeans_bac$centers

# Host genes
kmeans_euk <- kmeans(euk_z, centers = k_dia, iter.max = 50)
euk_genes <- data.frame(euk_z)
euk_genes$cid <- paste("h", kmeans_euk$cluster, sep = "_")
euk_genes$Gene_ID <- rownames(euk_genes)
euk_centroids <- kmeans_euk$centers
```

## Published cluster assignments

k-means starts from random centres, so cluster membership and numbering can
differ between R versions and machines even with the same seed. To reproduce the
published results exactly, the cluster assignments used in the manuscript are
read from `explore_bac_new.xlsx` and `explore_euk.xlsx`. The tables below compare
them with the k-means run above (a reproduced clustering shows one non-zero cell
per row and column, possibly with different numbering).

```{r published-clusters}
use_published_clusters <- TRUE

pub_bac <- read_xlsx(in_file("explore_bac_new.xlsx")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cid)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_ID, cid)
pub_euk <- read_xlsx(in_file("explore_euk.xlsx")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cid)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_ID, cid)

pub_bac_cid <- pub_bac$cid[match(bac_genes$Gene_ID, pub_bac$Gene_ID)]
pub_euk_cid <- pub_euk$cid[match(euk_genes$Gene_ID, pub_euk$Gene_ID)]

table(kmeans = bac_genes$cid, published = pub_bac_cid, useNA = "ifany")
table(kmeans = euk_genes$cid, published = pub_euk_cid, useNA = "ifany")

if (use_published_clusters) {
  if (anyNA(pub_bac_cid)) stop(sum(is.na(pub_bac_cid)), " bacterial genes have no published cluster")
  if (anyNA(pub_euk_cid)) stop(sum(is.na(pub_euk_cid)), " diatom genes have no published cluster")

  bac_genes$cid <- pub_bac_cid
  euk_genes$cid <- pub_euk_cid

  # Centroids = mean z-score per cluster (identical to k-means centres at convergence)
  cluster_centroids <- function(z, cid, prefix, k) {
    cen <- t(sapply(paste(prefix, seq_len(k), sep = "_"),
                    function(id) colMeans(z[cid == id, , drop = FALSE])))
    rownames(cen) <- as.character(seq_len(k))
    cen
  }
  bac_centroids <- cluster_centroids(bac_z, bac_genes$cid, "b", k_bac)
  euk_centroids <- cluster_centroids(euk_z, euk_genes$cid, "h", k_dia)
}
```

```{r centroid-plots}
matplot(t(bac_centroids), type = "l", col = 1:k_bac, lty = 1:k_bac,
        xlab = "Samples", ylab = "Expression", main = "Bacterial Gene Clusters")
legend("topright", legend = 1:k_bac, col = 1:k_bac, lty = 1:k_bac, cex = 0.7, title = "Cluster")

matplot(t(euk_centroids), type = "l", col = 1:k_dia, lty = 1:k_dia,
        xlab = "Samples", ylab = "Expression", main = "Host Gene Clusters")
legend("topright", legend = 1:k_dia, col = 1:k_dia, lty = 1:k_dia, cex = 0.7, title = "Cluster")
```

## Cluster tables for the module plots

The module plots (section 5) use gene and centroid tables in which bacterial

```{r module-tables}
  mutate(cid = sub("^b_", "m_", cid))

mod_bac_centroids <- as.data.frame(bac_centroids) %>%

mod_euk_centroids <- as.data.frame(euk_centroids) %>%
```

# 3. Centroid correlation and dendrogram

## Mean expression per cluster and sample

```{r cluster-means}
cluster_means <- function(genes) {
  genes %>%
    dplyr::select(-Gene_ID) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 1:16, names_to = "Treatment", values_to = "Expression") %>%
    group_by(Treatment, cid) %>%
    summarise(Expression = mean(Expression), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cid, values_from = Expression)
}

merged_data <- inner_join(cluster_means(bac_genes), cluster_means(euk_genes), by = "Treatment")
```

## Pairwise Pearson correlations

```{r correlations}
all_columns <- colnames(merged_data)[-1]

cor_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(all_columns), ncol = length(all_columns),
                     dimnames = list(all_columns, all_columns))
p_matrix <- cor_matrix

for (i in seq_along(all_columns)) {
  for (j in i:length(all_columns)) {
    test_result <- cor.test(merged_data[[all_columns[i]]], merged_data[[all_columns[j]]],
                            use = "complete.obs")
    cor_matrix[i, j] <- cor_matrix[j, i] <- test_result$estimate
    p_matrix[i, j]   <- p_matrix[j, i]   <- test_result$p.value
  }
}
```

## Cytoscape network input

Bacteria–host cluster pairs with p ≤ 0.05 and |r| ≥ 0.8.

```{r cytoscape}
cyto_matrix <- cor_matrix
cyto_matrix[p_matrix > 0.05] <- NA

cyto <- data.frame(cyto_matrix)
cyto <- cyto[!grepl("^h", rownames(cyto)), ]
cyto <- cyto[, !grepl("^b", colnames(cyto))]
cyto <- melt(as.matrix(cyto), varnames = c("Bac", "Diatom"), value.name = "Correlation")
cyto <- dplyr::filter(cyto, Correlation <= -0.8 | Correlation >= 0.8)
cyto

# write.table(cyto, out_file("cyto_new.txt"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

## Hierarchical clustering of clusters

```{r dendrogram, fig.width=12}
dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - abs(cor_matrix))
hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "average")

# postscript(out_file("dendrogram_new.eps"), width = 10, height = 5, paper = "special", horizontal = FALSE)
plot(hc, main = "Dendrogram of Hierarchical Clustering", xlab = "Clusters", sub = "",
     cex = 0.9, hang = -1)
# dev.off()

# Order used for the heatmap in section 6
cluster_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]
```

# 4. Global host–microbiome network

Diatom (rows) × bacterial (columns) matrices of positive and negative correlations.
Edge width scales with the absolute value, node size with degree. Host node `H_M`
is excluded from the network.

## Edges and nodes

```{r network-import}
set.seed(21)

# Positive matrix
df_pos <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx(in_file("global_network_pos.xlsx")))
rownames(df_pos) <- df_pos[[1]]
df_pos[[1]] <- NULL
df_pos <- df_pos[!(rownames(df_pos) == "H_M"), ]
mat_pos <- apply(df_pos, 2, as.numeric)

# Negative matrix
df_neg <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx(in_file("global_network_neg.xlsx")))
rownames(df_neg) <- df_neg[[1]]
df_neg[[1]] <- NULL
df_neg <- df_neg[!(rownames(df_neg) == "H_M"), ]
mat_neg <- apply(df_neg, 2, as.numeric)

cat("Positive matrix:", nrow(df_pos), "x", ncol(df_pos), "\n")
cat("Negative matrix:", nrow(df_neg), "x", ncol(df_neg), "\n")

# Edge lists (absolute values for thickness)
edges_pos <- expand.grid(diatom = rownames(df_pos), bacteria = colnames(df_pos),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
edges_pos$count <- as.vector(mat_pos)
edges_pos$type  <- "positive"
edges_pos <- edges_pos[!is.na(edges_pos$count) & edges_pos$count > 0, ]

edges_neg <- expand.grid(diatom = rownames(df_neg), bacteria = colnames(df_neg),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
edges_neg$count_raw <- as.vector(mat_neg)
edges_neg <- edges_neg[!is.na(edges_neg$count_raw) & edges_neg$count_raw < 0, ]
edges_neg$count <- abs(edges_neg$count_raw)
edges_neg$type  <- "negative"
edges_neg$count_raw <- NULL

edges_all <- rbind(edges_pos, edges_neg)
cat("Positive edges:", nrow(edges_pos), "\n")
cat("Negative edges:", nrow(edges_neg), "\n")
cat("Total edges:", nrow(edges_all), "\n")

# Nodes and graph
nodes_diatom   <- data.frame(name = rownames(df_pos), type = "diatom", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
nodes_bacteria <- data.frame(name = colnames(df_pos), type = "bacteria", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
nodes <- rbind(nodes_diatom, nodes_bacteria)

g_full <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_all[, c("diatom", "bacteria", "count", "type")],
  vertices = nodes,
  directed = FALSE
)

# Remove isolated nodes
deg_full <- degree(g_full)
isolates <- V(g_full)[deg_full == 0]
if (length(isolates) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(isolates), "isolated nodes\n")
  g <- delete_vertices(g_full, isolates)
} else {
  g <- g_full
}
```

## Styling and legends

```{r network-style}
# Edge styling
edge_width_range <- c(0.6, 10)
counts <- E(g)$count
count_min <- min(counts)
count_max <- max(counts)

if (count_max == count_min) {
  E(g)$width <- mean(edge_width_range)
} else {
  E(g)$width <- edge_width_range[1] +
    (counts - count_min) * (edge_width_range[2] - edge_width_range[1]) /
    (count_max - count_min)
}

E(g)$color <- ifelse(E(g)$type == "positive",
                     adjustcolor("darkblue", alpha.f = 0.7),
                     adjustcolor("darkred",  alpha.f = 0.7))
E(g)$curved <- 0.12

# Node styling
V(g)$color <- ifelse(V(g)$type == "diatom", "#90EE90", "#FFA500")
V(g)$shape <- "circle"

deg <- degree(g)
deg_min <- min(deg)
deg_max <- max(deg)
node_size_range <- c(4, 18)

if (deg_max == deg_min) {
  V(g)$size <- mean(node_size_range)
} else {
  V(g)$size <- node_size_range[1] +
    (deg - deg_min) * (node_size_range[2] - node_size_range[1]) /
    (deg_max - deg_min)
}

V(g)$label.cex <- 0.6
V(g)$label.color <- "black"

# Legend helpers
draw_edge_legend <- function(counts_vec, edge_width_range, xfrac = 0.02, y_bottomfrac = 0.15) {
  rep_counts <- unique(round(c(min(counts_vec), median(counts_vec), max(counts_vec)), 1))
  count_min <- min(counts_vec); count_max <- max(counts_vec)
  rep_widths <- edge_width_range[1] + (rep_counts - count_min) *
    (edge_width_range[2] - edge_width_range[1]) / (count_max - count_min)

  u <- par("usr")
  x_left  <- u[1] + xfrac * (u[2] - u[1])
  x_right <- x_left + 0.1 * (u[2] - u[1])
  y_start <- u[3] + y_bottomfrac * (u[4] - u[3])
  y_step  <- 0.035 * (u[4] - u[3])

  text(x = x_left, y = y_start + y_step * 2, labels = "Count → width", adj = 0, cex = 0.8)
  for (i in seq_along(rep_counts)) {
    y_i <- y_start + (i - 1) * y_step
    segments(x_left, y_i, x_right, y_i, lwd = rep_widths[i], col = "darkblue", lend = "round")
    text(x = x_right + 0.015 * (u[2] - u[1]), y = y_i, labels = rep_counts[i], adj = 0, cex = 0.75)
  }
}

draw_edge_type_legend <- function(xfrac = 0.75, y_bottomfrac = 0.15) {
  u <- par("usr")
  x_pos <- u[1] + xfrac * (u[2] - u[1])
  y_pos <- u[3] + y_bottomfrac * (u[4] - u[3])
  legend(x_pos, y_pos,
         legend = c("Positive correlation", "Negative correlation"),
         col = c("darkblue", "darkred"), lwd = 4, cex = 0.9, bty = "n")
}

draw_node_legend <- function(deg_vec, size_vec, xfrac = 0.02, y_topfrac = 0.85) {
  dmin <- min(deg_vec)
  dmax <- max(deg_vec)

  # Quantile-based representative degrees that exist in the data
  deg_breaks <- quantile(deg_vec, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  deg_vals <- c(floor(dmin), round(deg_breaks[1]), ceiling(dmax))
  deg_vals <- unique(deg_vals[deg_vals >= dmin & deg_vals <= dmax])

  u <- par("usr")
  x_center <- u[1] + xfrac * (u[2] - u[1])
  y_top  <- u[3] + y_topfrac * (u[4] - u[3])
  y_step <- 0.04 * (u[4] - u[3])

  text(x_center, y_top + y_step, "Degree → size", adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.8)

  for (i in seq_along(deg_vals)) {
    d <- deg_vals[i]
    idx <- which(deg_vec == d)[1]
    if (is.na(idx)) next
    s <- size_vec[idx]
    y_i <- y_top - i * y_step
    # cex = size / 3.5 matches igraph vertex.size
    points(x_center, y_i, pch = 21, cex = s / 3.5, bg = "grey70", col = "black", lwd = 0.5)
    text(x_center + 0.035 * (u[2] - u[1]), y_i, labels = d, adj = 0, cex = 0.75, font = 2)
  }
}

# Network plot with legends
plot_network <- function(layout) {
  plot(g, layout = layout, vertex.frame.color = NA,
       main = "Diatom–Bacterial Network (blue=+, red=−; size=degree)", margin = 0.12)
  draw_edge_legend(counts, edge_width_range)
  draw_edge_type_legend()
  draw_node_legend(deg, V(g)$size)
}
```

## Layouts

```{r network-fr, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
# Fruchterman-Reingold
set.seed(123)
layout_fr <- layout_with_fr(g, niter = 2000)
cairo_pdf(out_file("network_dual_fr.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)
plot_network(layout_fr)
dev.off()
plot_network(layout_fr)
```

```{r network-kk, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
# Kamada-Kawai
set.seed(42)
layout_kk <- layout_with_kk(g)
cairo_pdf(out_file("network_dual_kk.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)
plot_network(layout_kk)
dev.off()
plot_network(layout_kk)
```

```{r network-circular, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
# Grouped circular: diatoms on the left, bacteria on the right
n_d <- sum(V(g)$type == "diatom")
n_b <- sum(V(g)$type == "bacteria")
angles_d <- seq(pi/2, 3*pi/2, length.out = n_d + 1)[-(n_d + 1)]
angles_b <- seq(-pi/2, pi/2, length.out = n_b + 1)[-(n_b + 1)]
coords <- matrix(NA, nrow = vcount(g), ncol = 2)
coords[1:n_d, 1] <- cos(angles_d) * 1.2
coords[1:n_d, 2] <- sin(angles_d) * 1.2
coords[(n_d + 1):vcount(g), 1] <- cos(angles_b) * 1.2
coords[(n_d + 1):vcount(g), 2] <- sin(angles_b) * 1.2

cairo_pdf(out_file("network_dual_circular.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)
plot_network(coords)
dev.off()
plot_network(coords)
```

## Export for Cytoscape

```{r network-export}
edge_df <- data.frame(
  source      = V(g)[head_of(g, E(g))]$name,
  target      = V(g)[tail_of(g, E(g))]$name,
  interaction = E(g)$type,
  weight_abs  = E(g)$count,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(edge_df, out_file("network_edges_for_cytoscape.csv"), row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

node_df <- data.frame(
  name      = V(g)$name,
  type      = V(g)$type,
  degree    = degree(g),
  color_hex = V(g)$color,
  size_plot = V(g)$size,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(node_df, out_file("network_nodes_for_cytoscape.csv"), row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat("Nodes:", vcount(g), "(green=diatom, orange=bacteria; size=degree)\n")
cat("Total edges:", ecount(g), "(blue=positive, red=negative)\n")
cat("Edge |count| range:", round(count_min, 1), "-", round(count_max, 1), "\n")
cat("Node degree range:", round(deg_min, 1), "-", round(deg_max, 1), "\n")
```

# 5. Module expression profiles

Host and bacterial clusters were grouped into modules based on the network and
dendrogram above.

```{r module-setup}
meta_mod <- read.delim(in_file("DE_meta_combined.txt")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(treatment = Sample)

module_sample_order <- c("16.WP2.RNA.16", "17.WP2.RNA.17", "18.WP2.RNA.18", "19.WP2.RNA.19",
                         "06.WP2.RNA.6",  "07.WP2.RNA.7",  "08.WP2.RNA.8",  "09.WP2.RNA.9",
                         "01.WP2.RNA.1",  "02.WP2.RNA.2",  "03.WP2.RNA.3",  "04.WP2.RNA.4",
                         "26.WP2.RNA.26", "27.WP2.RNA.27", "28.WP2.RNA.28", "29.WP2.RNA.29")
treat_order <- c("D", "B", "A", "F")
```

```{r module-definitions}
module_defs <- list(
  module_1 = list(bac = "m_9",                                      euk = "h_6"),
  module_2 = list(bac = c("m_3", "m_4", "m_7", "m_16"),             euk = c("h_4", "h_1")),
  module_3 = list(bac = c("m_6", "m_10", "m_14"),                   euk = c("h_2", "h_10")),
  module_4 = list(bac = c("m_1", "m_13"),                           euk = c("h_7", "h_9", "h_11")),
  rest     = list(bac = c("m_12", "m_2", "m_11", "m_5", "m_15", "m_8"), euk = c("h_3", "h_5", "h_8"))
)

prepare_module <- function(def, name) {
  genes <- bind_rows(
    dplyr::filter(mod_bac_genes, cid %in% def$bac) %>% mutate(holo = "microbiome"),
    dplyr::filter(mod_euk_genes, cid %in% def$euk) %>% mutate(holo = "host")
  )
  centroids <- bind_rows(
    dplyr::filter(mod_bac_centroids, cid %in% def$bac) %>% mutate(holo = "microbiome"),
    dplyr::filter(mod_euk_centroids, cid %in% def$euk) %>% mutate(holo = "host")
  )

  genes_long <- genes %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 1:16, names_to = "treatment", values_to = "expression") %>%
    left_join(meta_mod, by = "treatment") %>%
    group_by(Treat, Gene_ID) %>%
    mutate(mean_gene = mean(expression), sd_gene = sd(expression)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = module_sample_order),
           Treat     = factor(Treat, levels = treat_order),
           mod       = name)

  centroids_long <- centroids %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 1:16, names_to = "treatment", values_to = "centroid") %>%
    left_join(meta_mod, by = "treatment") %>%
    group_by(Treat, cid) %>%
    mutate(mean_cen = mean(centroid), sd_cen = sd(centroid)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = module_sample_order),
           Treat     = factor(Treat, levels = treat_order),
           mod       = name)

  list(genes = genes_long, centroids = centroids_long)
}

modules <- imap(module_defs, prepare_module)
```

## Individual modules

```{r module-plot-function}
# Standard module plot (used for modules 1, 3, 4 and rest)
plot_module <- function(cen, n_col = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(cen, aes(x = Treat, y = mean_cen, col = cid, group = cid)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.1)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cen - sd_cen, ymax = mean_cen + sd_cen), width = 0.5,
                  position = position_dodge(0.1)) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  if (!is.null(n_col)) {
    clust_pal <- qualpal(n_col, colorspace = list(h = c(0, 360), s = c(0.3, 1), l = c(0.2, 0.8)))
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = clust_pal$hex)
  }
  p
}
```

# 6. Functional characterisation (COG categories)

## Annotation

```{r cog-annotation}
cog       <- read_xlsx(in_file("cog_categories.xlsx"))     # columns: COG_category, process
bac_annot <- read_xlsx(in_file("Bac_meta_cleaned.xlsx"))
euk_annot <- read_xlsx(in_file("signif_processes.xlsx"))

# Split multi-letter COG assignments into one row per letter and add the process
split_cog <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    mutate(COG_category = strsplit(as.character(COG_category), "")) %>%
    unnest(COG_category) %>%
    left_join(cog, by = "COG_category")
}

# Bacteria
bac_egg <- bac_genes %>%
  dplyr::select(cid, Gene_ID) %>%
  left_join(bac_annot %>% dplyr::rename(Gene_ID = query) %>% dplyr::select(Gene_ID, COG_category),
            by = "Gene_ID") %>%
  mutate(COG_category = ifelse(is.na(COG_category), "-", COG_category))
bac_egg_split <- split_cog(bac_egg)

# Host
euk_egg <- euk_annot %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene_ID = query) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_ID %in% euk_genes$Gene_ID) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(euk_genes, cid, Gene_ID), by = "Gene_ID")
euk_egg_split <- split_cog(euk_egg)

# COG categories significantly different between xenic and axenic diatoms
allowed_letters <- c("M", "O", "W", "Q", "F", "I", "P", "A", "B", "J", "L")
```

## Relative COG composition per cluster

```{r cog-composition}
processes <- c(metab = "metabolism",
               infor = "information_storage_processing",
               cellu = "cellular_processes_signaling")

# Counts and relative abundance of each COG letter per cluster.
# Totals are computed before host clusters are restricted to `allowed_letters`.
summarise_cog <- function(dat, restrict_host = FALSE) {
  counts <- dat %>%
    group_by(cid, COG_category) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  totals <- counts %>%
    group_by(cid) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
  if (restrict_host) {
    counts <- dplyr::filter(counts, !(grepl("^h_", cid) & !COG_category %in% allowed_letters))
  }
  relative <- counts %>%
    left_join(totals, by = "cid") %>%
    mutate(relative_abundance = count / total) %>%
    dplyr::select(cid, COG_category, relative_abundance)
  list(total = totals, relative = relative)
}

bac_sum <- map(processes, ~ summarise_cog(dplyr::filter(bac_egg_split, process == .x)))
euk_sum <- map(processes, ~ summarise_cog(dplyr::filter(euk_egg_split, process == .x),
                                          restrict_host = TRUE))

heat_df <- bind_rows(c(map(bac_sum, "relative"), map(euk_sum, "relative"))) %>%
  left_join(cog, by = "COG_category")

cluster_totals <- bind_rows(c(map(bac_sum, "total"), map(euk_sum, "total"))) %>%
  group_by(cid) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cluster_ID = cid)

summary_df <- heat_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cid, values_from = relative_abundance, values_fill = 0)
colnames(summary_df)[-1:-2] <- paste0("Cluster_", colnames(summary_df)[-1:-2])

long_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Cluster_"), names_to = "Cluster_ID",
               values_to = "Relative_Abundance") %>%
  mutate(Cluster_ID = gsub("Cluster_", "", Cluster_ID)) %>%
  left_join(cluster_totals, by = "Cluster_ID") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Total_Genes = total) %>%
  mutate(Cluster_ID = factor(Cluster_ID, levels = cluster_order)) %>%
  arrange(Cluster_ID)
```

## COG enrichment of bacterial clusters

Background: all bacteria-annotated genes in the reference transcriptome.
Hypergeometric tests per cluster, COG letter and process; categories with fewer
than 5 genes in a cluster are not tested.

```{r cog-background}
count_letters <- function(string) {
  letters <- unlist(strsplit(toupper(string), ""))
  letter_counts <- table(letters)
  data.frame(letter = names(letter_counts), count = as.numeric(letter_counts),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

ref_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(bac_annot$COG_category, count_letters)) %>%
  group_by(letter) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

ref_counts <- ref_counts[2:25, ] %>%               # remove not annotated symbol "-"
  dplyr::rename(COG_category = letter) %>%
  left_join(cog, by = "COG_category") %>%
  group_by(process) %>%
  mutate(rel_cog = count / sum(count), ref_sum = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r cog-enrichment}
egg <- left_join(bac_egg, dplyr::select(bac_genes, cid, Gene_ID), by = "Gene_ID")  # gives cid.x / cid.y
bac_split <- split_cog(egg)

cluster_bac <- bac_split %>%
  group_by(cid.x, COG_category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(COG_category != "-") %>%
  left_join(ref_counts, by = "COG_category") %>%
  dplyr::rename(count_ref = count, count_clust = Count) %>%
  dplyr::select(cid.x, COG_category, count_clust, count_ref, process, ref_sum) %>%
  group_by(cid.x, process) %>%
  mutate(clust_sum = sum(count_clust)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate enrichments
cluster_bac <- cluster_bac %>%
  mutate(pval_depleted = phyper(count_clust,     count_ref, ref_sum, clust_sum, lower.tail = TRUE),
         pval_enriched = phyper(count_clust - 1, count_ref, ref_sum, clust_sum, lower.tail = FALSE))

# cutoff processes with less than 5 genes
cluster_bac$pval_depleted <- ifelse(cluster_bac$count_clust < 5, paste("NA"), cluster_bac$pval_depleted)
cluster_bac$pval_enriched <- ifelse(cluster_bac$count_clust < 5, paste("NA"), cluster_bac$pval_enriched)

enriched_bac_genes <- cluster_bac %>%
  dplyr::filter(pval_enriched < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(unique_tile = paste(cid.x, COG_category, sep = "_"))

long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(unique_tile = paste(Cluster_ID, COG_category, sep = "_")) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(enriched_bac_genes, unique_tile, pval_enriched), by = "unique_tile") %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(pval_enriched < 0.05, paste("*"), pval_enriched))
```

## Heatmap

```{r cog-heatmap, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
genes_per_cluster <- bind_rows(dplyr::select(bac_egg_split, Gene_ID, cid),
                               dplyr::select(euk_egg_split, Gene_ID, cid)) %>%
  group_by(cid) %>%
```

# 7. Taxonomic composition of bacterial clusters

```{r taxonomy-import}
unique(tax_df$Class)
```

## Class-level composition per cluster

```{r taxonomy-clusters}
# Remove classes with < 1 % of genes within a cluster, then recompute relative abundance
tax_rel <- tax_df %>%
  group_by(cid.x, Class) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cid.x) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = count / sum(count)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(relative_abundance >= 0.01) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count),
         relative_abundance = count / total_count) %>%
  ungroup()

pal25 <- qualpal(25, colorspace = list(h = c(0, 360), s = c(0.3, 1), l = c(0.2, 0.8)))

p_class <- ggplot(tax_rel, aes(x = cid.x, y = relative_abundance, fill = Class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Relative Abundance of Organism Classes", x = "Class", y = "Relative Abundance") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_grid(~ cid.x, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal25$hex) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_class
# ggsave(out_file("cluster_class.eps"), p_class, device = "eps", units = "cm", height = 13, width = 20, dpi = 300)
```

## Class composition of the top-5 COG categories per cluster

```{r taxonomy-cog, fig.height=9}
tax_split <- tax_df %>%
  mutate(COG_category = strsplit(as.character(COG_category), "")) %>%
  unnest(COG_category) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!COG_category %in% c("-", "NA", "S")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Class %in% c("Cyanobacteria", "other", "Aconoidasida", "Halobacteria"))

# Remove classes with < 5 % within a cluster x COG category, then recompute relative abundance
tax_cog_rel <- tax_split %>%
  group_by(cid.x, COG_category, Class) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cid.x, COG_category) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = count / sum(count)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(relative_abundance >= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count),
         relative_abundance = count / total_count) %>%
  ungroup()

unique_gene_counts <- tax_split %>%
  group_by(cid.x, COG_category) %>%
  summarise(unique_gene_count = n_distinct(Gene_ID), .groups = "drop")

top_cog_categories <- unique_gene_counts %>%
  group_by(cid.x) %>%
  top_n(5, wt = unique_gene_count) %>%
  ungroup()

bac_order <- c("Alphaproteobacteria", "Betaproteobacteria", "Gammaproteobacteria", "Deltaproteobacteria",
               "Acidobacteriia", "Actinobacteria", "Aquificae", "Bacilli", "Clostridia",
               "Bacteroidia", "Chloroflexia", "Deinococci", "Thermococci", "Verrucomicrobiae",
               "not_annotated")

tax_cog_top <- tax_cog_rel %>%
  semi_join(top_cog_categories, by = c("cid.x", "COG_category")) %>%
  left_join(unique_gene_counts, by = c("cid.x", "COG_category")) %>%
  mutate(Class = factor(Class, levels = bac_order))

pal21 <- qualpal(21, colorspace = list(h = c(0, 360), s = c(0.3, 1), l = c(0.2, 0.8)))

p_cog_class <- ggplot(tax_cog_top, aes(x = COG_category, y = relative_abundance, fill = Class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = unique_gene_count), position = position_stack(vjust = 1.05),
            size = 3, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Relative Abundance of Organism Classes", x = "COG Category", y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal21$hex) +
  facet_wrap(cid.x ~ ., scales = "free_x") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
p_cog_class

ggsave(out_file("cluster_cog_class.eps"), p_cog_class, device = "eps",
       units = "cm", height = 19, width = 19, dpi = 300)
```
